# STA Corporate Solutions

> Coimbatore-headquartered corporate solutions group since 1982 — Transportation, Financial Services, Legal Services, Edu Consultancy and Real Estate for South India.

STA Corporate Solutions provides Full Load lorry transport across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and Kerala; business loan assistance (MSME, Mudra, PMEGP and government funding scheme guidance); corporate, property and family legal services; education consultancy; and real estate discovery. Headquartered in Peelamedu, Coimbatore. Contact: +91 94430 33055.
